title: Elderly fall
stem: Cubicle 9. Mr Stephens, 83, was found on his kitchen floor this morning by his son. He has left hip pain and feels sick. Take a history, then discuss investigations and your plan.

review.text: The World Falls Guidelines (2022) add a frailty assessment and prefer case-finding with risk stratification to a single risk score. Your template otherwise matches.

notes:
Checked against NICE CG161 (Falls in older people, 2013; new NG249 falls guideline 2025 draft/publication noted), the World Falls Guidelines (Age and Ageing 2022), and NICE CG124 (hip fracture).

A fall is a symptom: find why he fell (syncope, arrhythmia, postural hypotension, stroke, infection, hypoglycaemia, medicines, alcohol, trip), what he injured (hip fracture, head injury — anticoagulants lower the CT threshold), and what the long lie caused (rhabdomyolysis, pressure injury, hypothermia, dehydration, AKI). Then a multifactorial risk assessment: previous falls, gait and mobility, medication review (sedatives, antihypertensives), vision, cognition, continence, home hazards, fear of falling, bone health.

Your template and marking scheme match this well. The World Falls Guidelines add frailty assessment and prefer 'opportunistic case-finding' and risk stratification over single scores.

steps.label: History
steps.hint: Before, during and after the fall; injuries; long lie; PMH, drugs, social, function.

Start.t: Are you in pain? Can I get you something?
Start.tz: 你有冇痛？我攞啲止痛藥俾你好嗎？
Start.rz: 我左邊髖關節痛到死。好呀，唔該。
Start.r: My left hip is killing me. Yes please.

Before.t: What were you doing when you fell?
Before.rz: 半夜去完廁所，起身行去廚房攞水飲。
Before.r: Getting up from the toilet at night to go to the kitchen for water.
Before.mark: Asks the activity at the time

Before.t: Any warning — dizziness, palpitations, chest pain?
Before.tz: 跌之前有冇預兆——頭暈、心跳、心口痛？
Before.rz: 企起身嗰陣覺得頭輕輕，跟住就喺地下喇。
Before.r: I felt light-headed when I stood up, then I was on the floor.

During.t: Did you black out? Did you hit your head?
During.tz: 你有冇暈低？有冇撞到個頭？
During.r: I don't think so. I didn't hit my head.
During.mark: Asks about loss of consciousness and head injury

During.t: Any tongue biting, wet yourself, jerking?
During.tz: 有冇咬到條脷、失禁，或者手腳抽搐？

After.t: Could you get up? How long were you on the floor?
After.tz: 你自己起唔起到身？喺地下躺咗幾耐？
After.rz: 起唔到身。大概六個鐘，個仔嚟到先發現。
After.r: Couldn't get up. About 6 hours until my son came.

After.t: Any other pain, weakness, confusion since?
After.tz: 之後有冇其他地方痛、冇力，或者混亂？
After.r: Just the hip. And I feel sick.

Background.rz: 血壓高，同埋前列腺。食緊 amlodipine、doxazosin、一隻去水丸，同埋安眠藥。
Background.r: High blood pressure, prostate. Amlodipine, doxazosin, a water tablet, and sleeping tablets.
Background.mark: Takes a medication history (falls risk drugs)

Background.t: Who do you live with? How do you get around? Help at home?
Background.tz: 你同邊個住？平時點行動？屋企有冇人幫手？
Background.rz: 老婆過咗身之後一個人住。用枴杖行。個仔日日都嚟探我。
Background.r: Alone since my wife died. Walk with a stick. Son visits daily.

Background.tz: 你眼睛、記性點？有冇飲酒？
Background.rz: 左眼有白內障。記性還可以。夜晚飲一杯威士忌。
Background.r: Cataract in my left eye. Memory OK. A glass of whisky at night.

steps.label: Findings and tests
steps.hint: Lying and standing BP, ECG, glucose, CK, bloods, hip film.

Bloods.mark: CK and renal function after a long lie

X-ray.r: Displaced intracapsular neck of femur fracture.
X-ray.mark: Hip X-ray: neck of femur fracture

steps.ask: Thank you. What is your plan?
steps.label: Plan
steps.hint: Treat the injury, the cause and the consequences; multifactorial falls assessment.

opts.t: Fascia iliaca block and paracetamol; orthopaedics for surgery within 36 hours
opts.mark: Analgesia (nerve block) and hip fracture pathway

opts.t: IV fluids for AKI and rhabdomyolysis; monitor urine output
opts.mark: Treats the consequences of the long lie

opts.t: Postural hypotension: review doxazosin, diuretic, sleeping tablets
Geriatric and therapy assessment: falls, bone health, home safety, alarm
opts.mark: Multifactorial falls assessment and bone health

qs.q: Postural hypotension is a systolic fall of at least…
wrong: 50 mmHg within 10 minutes of standing up
Any fall in blood pressure on standing up

qs.q: Target time to hip fracture surgery (NICE)?
qs.a: Day of or after admission (within 36 h)
wrong: Only once medically stable, usually at 2 weeks

qs.q: Which drug class increases falls risk?
wrong: Proton pump inhibitors such as omeprazole

qs.q: Nerve block for a hip fracture in ED?
wrong: Digital nerve block of the toes

badge.name: Why He Fell
badge.flavor: The cause, the injury, the long lie, then the risks.

options: Why, what was injured, what did the lie cause
Where, who saw it, and how much it hurt
When, what time, and which floor

cards.q: Lying and standing BP is measured after standing for…
cards.why: A fall of ≥20 systolic or ≥10 diastolic.

cards.q: CK is raised after a long lie because of…

options: Regular NSAIDs such as ibuprofen for everyone
IM morphine only, as needed, on the ward
cards.why: Fascia iliaca or femoral nerve block.

cards.q: After a fall with fracture, what else is assessed?
